QuestInfo.name: [Collector's Request] Alcaster's Teacher
QuestInfo.0: You meet Alcaster in El Nath. What will he know?
QuestInfo.1:
When you say that Aurelia and Sayram were allies, Alcaster remembers when an #binjured Warrior#k came looking for his teacher. Despite Aurelia's worries, Sayram left with #ba shield and a necklace#k. Alcaster tells you to search for clues of his #bteacher's keepsake#k in the #bClosed Lab#k.

#b(* If a problem occurs during the quest, forfeit the quest and try again.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Alcaster told you to find #bAurelia's keepsake#k in the #bClosed Lab#k that he used long ago.

0.0: What's that book in your hand there? Oh, #bSayram#k? I never met him, but how could I not know the #bhero from the war 300 years ago#k? Time has inexplicably forgotten him, but I can assure you he existed.
0.1: Hm? You say the book mentions my #bteacher#k?
0.2: And this warrior... Could the #bWarrior back then#k have been Sayram...?
0.3: Let me recount some history. My teacher, Aurelia, defended a stronghold with her allies at the height of the #bwar 300 years ago#k. It was a do-or-die battle. Despite the prowess of the adventurers there, only #bonly Aurelia and one other survived#k.
0.4: Perhaps the #bshock of losing all her allies was too much#k, but Aurelia chose to #bseclude herself to El Nath#k. I can only speculate about her reasons, though. She wasn't the type to talk about it.
0.5: One night, an #binjured Warrior rode in on a Griffey#k to come see Aurelia. I didn't know it at the time, but surely he was #bSayram#k. I was asked to treat his wounds, so I caught parts of their argument.
0.6: Sayram said he needed to go, but Aurelia pleaded with him to reconsider. Eventually, she relented and saw him off with #bhis shield and her prized necklace#k. He never returned.
0.7: Sayram went on to #bsave many people through his heroic efforts, before eventually perishing in the war 300 years ago.#k Unfortunately, I don't know what else they discussed that night or where Sayram went afterward.
0.8: If you're looking for #bSayram's relic#k, you may find a clue in my teacher's keepsake. You can find it in the #bClosed Lab in Orbis#k that I used long ago.
0.9: I'll send you there right away.\r\n#b#e(Accept to move to the next quest location.)#n#k

0.msg: This feels like looking for a needle in a haystack...

1.msg: Huh? A necklace and a journal...
